commits.messageBody:
…ign release 1 offers Dashboard, Address book, Manage account and Log out on every page

The service navigation bar rendered the service name alone, and a bespoke
strip below it carried the signed-in user's email and a "Sign out" link.
Design release 1 puts four items in the bar on every page and shows no
signed-in identity.

layout.njk now passes a navigation array to govukServiceNavigation for
authenticated requests: Dashboard (/), Address book, Manage account and
Log out (/auth/sign-out). Address book and Manage account point at a
placeholder, as Design release 1 does for the account page, because
neither has a home in this service yet. Item labels live in
copy.en.js/copy.cy.js under layout.serviceNavigation, alongside the
menu-button text for the mobile toggle.

The active item is resolved server-side: paths.js gains inDashboardSection
and context.js an activeNavigationItem field, so every notification page
marks Dashboard as the current section. application.js instantiates
govuk-frontend's ServiceNavigation so the mobile menu button works.

The bespoke service-header component (template.njk, macro.njk,
_service-header.scss) is deleted along with its call from the layout, so
sign-out now lives only in the navigation.

Covered by layout.test.js, copy.test.js, context.test.js and a new
service-navigation.fit.spec.js.

Increment inc-007 of the DR1 parity backlog. Ticket EUDPA-342.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
